capabilities: Display a GitHub-style activity heatmap of note activity with time-range filters
Break down notes by top-level folder with drill-down and share-of-parent bars
Configure up to 5 quick-access blocks listing a folder's recently modified notes
Parse markdown changelogs as an alternative heatmap data source
Jump from a changelog heatmap cell to that day's section
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no single overview pane showing when notes were worked on, how notes are distributed across folders, and shortcuts to active folders.
summary: Vault dashboard that shows a note-activity heatmap, a folder-distribution breakdown, and configurable quick-access folder links in one pane.
